_note: New actor, first pricing entry. One event per game with every market asked for. Rivals: lergassy/pinnacle-odds-api $0.006/game + $0.002/odds row; parseforge $0.007/item + $0.054 start. $0.004 per game, no start fee, no per-run allowance (polled). onlyChanged skips unchanged games free. No proxy.

game_odds.eventDescription: One game from Pinnacle with every market you asked for (moneyline, spread, total, team totals, periods, alternates), each outcome with American and decimal odds, implied and vig-free fair probability, plus the market's margin and max stake. With 'Only games whose odds moved' on, unchanged games are skipped and not charged.
